# Kanaky Tech

> Kanaky Tech is an AI automation and agent-development studio for the Pacific, founded by Kevyn Wahuzue. It builds custom AI agents, automates business processes, produces AI-powered visuals and video, and delivers private, reliable AI systems for SMEs, agencies and institutions across New Caledonia, New Zealand and the wider Pacific — including work shipped white-label under a partner's brand.

Kanaky Tech is based in Nouméa (New Caledonia) and Auckland (New Zealand). The approach is local, bilingual (French and English), grounded in real business problems, and built so a human stays in control. A first AI opportunity audit is offered free of charge as the starting point.

## What Kanaky Tech does
- [AI Opportunity Audit](https://kanaky.xyz/ai-audit/): a free audit that maps a business's workflows and identifies where AI saves the most time and money, with prioritised opportunities and a starting point.
- [Business Process Automation](https://kanaky.xyz/business-process-automation/): automating repetitive, rule-based tasks — quotes, follow-ups, reporting, data entry, customer replies.
- [AI Agent Development](https://kanaky.xyz/ai-agents-new-caledonia/): custom AI agents grounded in a business's own data and tools, not generic chatbots.
- [Private AI Systems](https://kanaky.xyz/private-ai-systems/): AI in a controlled environment — client data is never used to train public models; engagements available under NDA.

## Who it serves
- Small and medium businesses wanting to remove time-consuming manual work.
- Creative and digital agencies needing a white-label AI production and automation partner that delivers under their brand.
- Tradespeople (electricians, plumbers, builders) using AI voice-to-quote to turn after-hours admin into minutes.
- Institutions and public bodies, including open-data and heritage projects.

## Flagship product
- [Keou](https://keou.systems/): private, white-label AI creative-production platform for agencies. An agency uploads a product photo and generates commercial visuals, videos, voiceovers and format variants in minutes, at AI-API cost (~$0.09/image) instead of the traditional ~$18 and ~25 minutes per visual. Includes a Studio, an agentic AI creative-director chat, export packs, a tokenized client-approval portal under the agency's brand, and a built-in ROI report. Read the [full overview](https://kanaky.xyz/blog/keou-ai-creative-production/).

## Proof & projects
- [Case studies](https://kanaky.xyz/case-studies/)
- [MCP for data.gouv.nc](https://kanaky.xyz/mcp-datagouvnc/): connecting New Caledonia's open-data portal to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol.
- [Dictionary of the Kanak languages](https://dictionnaire.kanaky.xyz/): a free online dictionary uniting 9 Kanak languages and 19,672 words, with native-speaker audio, an offline mode, and a retrieval-grounded AI assistant — built by Kanaky Tech.
